functionInfos.body:
const c = {{f_upload_content}};
return c != null &&
  typeof c === "object" &&
  !Array.isArray(c) &&
  Object.keys(c).length > 0 &&
  String(c?.submissionId ?? "").trim().length > 0 &&
  Array.isArray(c?.files) &&
  c.files.length > 0;
